## v0.4

- Buttons in the menu: assign any button (including a short press of OK) to page forward, page back, light, sleep, or off.
- A D-pad on the remote screen that shows what each button is set to and lights up the one you press.

## v0.3

- A new screen: Bluetooth and battery status in a header, and a key legend that lights up the key you press.

## v0.2

- The bottom line of the screen is no longer cut off.

## v0.1

- First release: page forward and back, light, sleep, and the Flipper's battery level on the Kindle.
